readerAnswers.news: CRISP analyses those images. In an observational study, meaning researchers watched normal care, it beat other AI models.
readerAnswers.mechanism: CRISP gives a prediction; the pathologist still interprets the tissue and informs the surgical team.
readerAnswers.limit: This does not show that CRISP improves treatment or patient outcomes.

terms.frozen section: A frozen section is tissue quickly frozen, sliced and examined during surgery.
terms.observational study: In an observational study, meaning researchers watched normal care, it beat other AI models.

explainBack: A frozen section is prepared quickly during surgery, making it hard to read. CRISP adds a prediction, but the specialist interprets the tissue; a comparison result is not evidence that patients do better.
unseenTransfer: If another medical AI matches a specialist in a study, ask whether researchers only compared readings or changed care and measured what happened to patients.
limitations: Producer review is not independent admission.
No patient benefit or availability claim is made.
